Voting Rules
  • Choose exactly 1 game.
  • One participant = one ballot.
  • Vote only in the region where you are an official member.
  • Only RU and Nigeria regional votes are counted.
  • No paid votes. Only role weight affects voting power.
  • Cross-region and duplicate voting will not be counted.
